evidenceQuality.summary: Round 1 rejected the unexecutable 'to_response(story, foreign viewer, viewed_ids=set())' formula; revision 2 pins the executable invariant (to_broadcast_response(story, owner) equals the item list_feed(foreign_viewer_id) returns for that story, foreign viewer with no StoryView rows) in the requirement, AC-BE-WS and plan.md. The frame-order owner-exclusion proof is sound and deterministic (a sync TestClient POST returns only after the in-process broadcast, so a leaked story_created would queue before any later pong); HTTP-while-WS-open has the existing reaction precedent (test_social_api.py:255-263); the sync TestClient template citation (test_http_and_ws.py:115-154) is exact; the <=3-sockets cap respects TestClient portal capacity. The insert-position criterion reproduces the server order (own block is a prefix, others unviewed-before-viewed, newest-first within groups — services/stories.py:66-71, repositories/stories.py:37-45). Gates match the accepted repo evidence contract, including the documented Windows-only ingestion-converter caveat.

residualRisk.summary: S1 tier justified: additive endpoint + hub, chat WS protocol untouched, cookie auth + Origin check copied verbatim, no migration. Non-goals honestly bound the tails: off-page events, owner's other tabs, TTL expiry vs a pushed ring, viewer-of-deleted-story, the refetch-vs-insert race (id-dedupe keeps it convergent), no logout close (closeAllChatSockets verified to have no production call site). One NIT-level residual does not block freeze: WS-BE-STORIES-PUSH plannedItems 3 and 6 still carry the pre-revision shorthand ('to_broadcast_response(story)' and '== to_response(story, foreign viewer, empty viewed)'), and plan.md's event-contract prose (line 29) likewise omits the owner parameter; the executable form is pinned unambiguously in the same manifest's requirement description and AC-BE-WS statement and in plan.md steps 3-5, which the worker packet also receives via contextRefs.
